title: Inactivate a Position
goal: Set a position to Inactive from the right date, with the reason recorded.
context: Screen steps are taken from the HCM job aid 'Inactivate Position in Oracle Cloud' (last updated 7/21/25). DRAFT FOR SME REVIEW: the 'check the position is vacant' checkpoint, the hints and the follow-up reminder describe sensible practice but are not from a published SOP. Confirm them and the contacts with the HCM Academy team.

steps.title: Check it's empty
steps.instruction: Have the position number. Make sure no one is in it.
steps.why: Inactivating a filled position breaks that person's record.
steps.confirm: It's empty and I have the number

steps.title: Open Manage Positions
steps.instruction: Our Workforce > Workforce Structures > Manage Positions.

steps.title: Find the position
steps.instruction: Enter Business Unit, Code and As-of Date. Search.
steps.expect: The position shows in the results.
hints: Nothing found? Check the As-of Date.

check.question: What goes in the Code field?

steps.title: Open it and choose Update
steps.instruction: Click the Position Name. Then Edit > Update.
steps.expect: It asks for a date and action reason.
hints: Check the code matches your number first.

steps.title: Check the date
steps.instruction: Make sure the date is when it should go inactive.
steps.expect: The date is the day it goes inactive.
steps.why: It's active up to this date, inactive from it.

steps.title: Set the action reason
steps.why: This tells reporting and audit what changed.

check.question: Which action reason?
check.why: Action Reason is Inactivate Position. Inactive goes in Status.

check.question: What do you set Status to?
check.why: Status is Inactive. You need both fields.

steps.title: Review
steps.expect: The review shows the position as Inactive.

callouts.say: The Code field is the position number.
callouts.source: Inactivate Position in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 7/21/25

callouts.say: Both fields must be set: Action Reason to Inactivate Position, and Status to Inactive.
callouts.source: Inactivate Position in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 7/21/25

reminders.say: Search for the position again and check it shows as Inactive from the effective date.

recap.summary: You set the position to Inactive from the right date, with the reason and a comment.
nextSteps: Check the position shows as Inactive in Manage Positions.
